Image preparation: projectOffloadedImages, vision-model and role admission checks, per-attachment request versions, assertImagesFit raising IMAGE_OFFLOAD_REQUIRED with the count of oldest occurrences to offload, prepareFileIds recording each occurrence.

prepareRequestExtensions: merges plugin fields, refuses a base-field collision, and on a serialization failure falls back to the base body alone with a no-op accept so contributors resend their unaccepted state later.

RequestFiles: per-image Files resolution under its own deadline, one bounded stale-id retry, staleMapping() preferring an exact file-id mention, and a normalized-image rejection diagnostic that names the actual occurrence.

Provider-side request-image pricing: resolveRequestImageTarget (token grid, pixel budget, 4096 px per-side cap, encoded-byte target), deepSeekImageRequestPricing pricing text-only routes as their deterministic substitution and offloaded occurrences as placeholder text.

Messages request serialization: system snapshots, tool_addition/tool_removal references, reasoning blocks carrying their replay signature, empty assistant text dropped, max_tokens defaulting from the model then the route, thinking/output_config effort mapping.

SSE framing via eventsource-parser: heartbeat comments pulse the idle watchdog, an unterminated tail is not an event, invalid JSON and event-type mismatch are MALFORMED_RESPONSE, an error event becomes a provider error.

Stream translation: block order preserved, signature_delta accumulated into the replay block, cumulative disjoint usage (input/cacheRead/cacheWrite/output), finish reason mapping, truncated tool JSON kept in the stream but validated as JSON unless the reason is max-tokens.

providerError classification: AUTH/QUOTA/RATE_LIMIT/CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED/INVALID_REQUEST/SERVER from status and provider type, plus retry-after parsing (numeric seconds or HTTP date) and request-id extraction from three header spellings.

normalizeLlmFailure: detaches serializable provider facts from a thrown value, reading only own data descriptors so a hostile SDK accessor cannot replace the failure, and trusting a carried snapshot only when code and failure agree.
normalizeApiKey: the one definition of a well-formed provider key (printable ASCII, space excluded, Latin-1 excluded) with silent trimming and empty/illegalCharacters verdicts.

BlockAssembler: the canonical chunk-to-message assembly; first block-start wins, block-end freezes a block and later deltas are ignored, unknown chunk types hit assertNever, and replay entries are pruned in step with the emitted blocks.

Compact timed assistant stream: the accumulator packs consecutive deltas into runs with dt gaps, expandAssistantStream reconstructs the exact timed chunk sequence, and record-level readers answer first-token/visible-content questions without expanding (a retained expansion costs ~10x).

APP_IDENTITY sourced from the package manifest (never a hand-copied constant), userAgent() rendering product/version (+url), and attributionHeaders() returning only user-agent so attribution cannot be suppressed.
Branded ids owned by dsh-llm: MessageId, ToolCallId, ProviderRequestId, LlmAttemptId, ReasoningEffortId, each with a nominal constructor over brandString.

Call-config vocabulary: LlmCallControls/LlmCallConfig, the pure ConfigureCall callback contract, callConfigEquals as the real-change detector (element-wise on stop), and the WeakSet marking loop-built requests.

Shared content helpers: file handle text (the only representation a provider ever receives for a file), image handle/offload/text-only placeholder texts, requiredImageOffload computing the oldest occurrences to remove in whole quanta, and projectToolUpdates selecting per-route tool-update behaviour.

HarnessError/LlmError taxonomy and the canonical codes CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED, QUOTA, ACCOUNT_QUOTA, EMPTY_RESPONSE, INVALID_CREDENTIAL, IMAGE_OFFLOAD_REQUIRED, plus the regex-based context-overflow and quota classifiers.

LlmRuntime service (1218 lines): adapter registry with atomic route/directory commit, configurable-provider directory, model discovery, prepareCall binding one adapter generation, the streaming waterfall, and adapterStream turning any adapter throw into one terminal error/aborted finish chunk.

Message value types: immutable constructors, the semantic ContextForm vocabulary (instructions/catalog/snapshot/notice/relay/recall), the 120-char notice summary bound, and the merge-extensible MessageSourceMap.
Provider-owned retry policy: normal and always modes, defaults (5 retries, 500 ms to 10 s, 10% jitter, five retryable codes), strict unknown-key rejection and an immutable frozen result.

The canonical vocabulary: ContentBlockMap, FinishReasonMap, TokenUsage with disjoint buckets, LlmResolvedModelInfo (context/defaultMaxTokens/reasoning/systemPromptUpdate/toolUpdate), ReplayEnvelope, StreamChunk, ToolSchema, GenerateOptions and ToolHistory.

Failure-normalization tests: hostile Symbol.toPrimitive, accessor-backed code/failure properties, proxy traps on getOwnPropertyDescriptor, and a throwing message accessor all degrade to {message:'LLM adapter failed',code:'UNKNOWN'}.
